title: When the Choir Turns Anew
author: Cyrus Nakamura
blurb: Mirabel Whitlock, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
